Grey Leaf

Biography

Grey Leaf speaks for the Green Clan of the Woodsfolk. He asks Zak to help their kidnapped elder Khabburu and distinguishes the clan’s arrows from the forged evidence used against them. When the clan moves, he opens its hidden route to Zak. His observations of the cloaked woman near the mines provide a crucial clue to the Princess’s imprisonment. [1, 2, 3, 4]
